1.0.2: Added output examples to component schemas.
1.1.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Zoom API.
1.1.1: Fixed a crash when a Find/List component saved an EMPTY result set to a CSV file — the header row was built from the first record without checking there was one, so a search that legitimately matched nothing failed the flow instead of writing an empty file.
1.1.2: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
